name: Star Interplanetary Broad Search
description: Ballistic Star grid search: Lambert arcs patched by approximate powered flybys, followed by time-bin filtering. DSM, null and resonant legs are rejected. Typed SLP/OEM inputs; signed PSS output with a separate PCE model and budget report. Signed execution targets WasmEdge because SDK 0.9.8 restricts wallet_sign to server runtimes.

attribution.algorithmOrigin: The Star algorithm is originally due to Damon Landau. The vendored upstream is an independent open re-implementation; this module is a C++ port of that re-implementation.
algorithmCitations: Landau, D., Campagnola, S., & Pellegrini, E. (2022). Star searches for patched-conic trajectories. The Journal of the Astronautical Sciences, 69(6), 1613-1648. https://doi.org/10.1007/s40295-022-00350-y
Landau, D. (2018). Efficient maneuver placement for automated trajectory design. Journal of Guidance, Control, and Dynamics, 41(7), 1531-1541.
Arora, N., & Russell, R. P. (2013). A fast and robust multiple revolution Lambert algorithm using a cosine transformation. AAS/AIAA Astrodynamics Specialist Conference, AAS 13-728, Hilton Head, SC.

threading.parallelism: row-range over Lambert batch solves and leg/flyby database construction
threading.determinism: Output is bit-identical at every thread count: fixed row-range partitioning, preallocated output slots (never completion-order append), fixed-index-order reductions.
threading.spawnFailurePolicy: wasi.thread-spawn may return -1 (browser lane without cross-origin isolation). The inline single-threaded fallback is mandatory and produces identical output.
threading.threadCountSource: explicit parameter / environment — never hardware-concurrency detection in guest code (no SDK discovery hook exists)

acceptedTypeSets.description: Sun-centered ECLIPJ2000/TDB OEM states; up to eight-point Lagrange interpolation inside coverage, no extrapolation.

inputPorts.description: Planetary ephemeris with explicit NAIF body identifiers and source MESSAGE_ID.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Ratified solver/search problem definition carrying variables, bounds, objectives, constraints, solver settings, and generic evaluator and propagator port identifiers.
Ratified multi-solution container with objective vectors, feasibility, constraint violations, dominance ranks, verify-by-propagation residuals, and module provenance.

outputPorts.description: Pareto-optimal trajectory set carried by the ratified signed $PSS record.

methods.description: Run ballistic encounter, leg, flyby and combination search with deterministic time-bin filtering. Emit a requested page in native order; no global optimum or Pareto-front claim.
